description: This file defines the interface for the RBUS core API, including function declarations, callback types, constants, and macros for bus communication, object and event management, and private connection handling.

methods.name: rbus_getOpenTelemetryContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current OpenTelemetry context strings.

methods.name: rbus_setOpenTelemetryContext
methods.description: Sets the OpenTelemetry context with provided strings.

methods.name: rbus_clearOpenTelemetryContext
methods.description: Clears the current OpenTelemetry context.

methods.name: rbus_openBrokerConnection
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the bus broker with a component name.

methods.name: rbus_openBrokerConnection2
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the bus broker with a component name and broker address.

methods.name: rbus_closeBrokerConnection
methods.description: Closes the connection to the bus broker.

methods.name: rbus_getConnection
methods.description: Returns the underlying rtMessage connection handle.

methods.name: rbus_registerObj
methods.description: Registers an object with the bus, associating a handler callback.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterObj
methods.description: Unregisters an object from the bus.

methods.name: rbus_addElement
methods.description: Adds an element (attribute) to a registered object.

methods.name: rbus_removeElement
methods.description: Removes an element from a registered object.

methods.name: rbus_registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a remote method for an object.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterMethod
methods.description: Unregisters a remote method from an object.

methods.name: rbus_registerMethodTable
methods.description: Registers multiple methods in bulk for an object.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterMethodTable
methods.description: Unregisters multiple methods in bulk for an object.

methods.name: rbus_invokeRemoteMethod
methods.description: Invokes a remote method synchronously, blocking until response or timeout.

methods.name: rbus_invokeRemoteMethod2
methods.description: Invokes a remote method with a specific connection handle.

methods.name: rbus_invokeRemoteMethodAsync
methods.description: Invokes a remote method asynchronously, with callback on response.

methods.name: rbus_publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event to all subscribers.

methods.name: rbus_registerEvent
methods.description: Registers an event for subscription.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterEvent
methods.description: Unregisters an event.

methods.name: rbus_addElementEvent
methods.description: Adds an event as an element to an object.

methods.name: rbus_registerTimedUpdateEventCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to generate timed update events.

methods.name: rbus_subscribeToEvent
methods.description: Subscribes to events from an object.

methods.name: rbus_subscribeToEventTimeout
methods.description: Subscribes to events with a timeout.

methods.name: rbus_unsubscribeFromEvent
methods.description: Unsubscribes from event notifications.

methods.name: rbus_registerSubscribeHandler
methods.description: Registers a callback for client subscriptions.

methods.name: rbus_registerMasterEventHandler
methods.description: Registers a callback for all received events.

methods.name: rbus_registerClientDisconnectHandler
methods.description: Registers a callback for client disconnects.

methods.name: rbus_unregisterClientDisconnectHandler
methods.description: Unregisters the disconnect callback.

methods.name: rbus_publishSubscriberEvent
methods.description: Sends an event directly to a specific subscriber.

methods.name: rbuscore_publishDirectSubscriberEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event directly to a specific listener.

methods.name: rbus_pushObj
methods.description: Sets a remote object value, blocking until response.

methods.name: rbus_pushObjNoAck
methods.description: Sets a remote object value without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: rbus_pullObj
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a remote object.

methods.name: rbus_subscribeToTimedUpdateEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to periodic timed update events.

methods.name: rbus_unsubscribeFromTimedUpdateEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes from timed update events.

methods.name: rbus_discoverWildcardDestinations
methods.description: Discovers destinations matching a wildcard expression.

methods.name: rbus_discoverObjectElements
methods.description: Discovers elements of an object.

methods.name: rbus_discoverElementObjects
methods.description: Discovers objects associated with a specific element.

methods.name: rbus_discoverElementsObjects
methods.description: Discovers objects for multiple elements.

methods.name: rbus_discoverRegisteredComponents
methods.description: Lists all registered RBUS components.

methods.name: rbuscore_checkBusStatus
methods.description: Checks if RBUS bus is enabled.

methods.name: rbus_sendResponse
methods.description: Sends a reply response to a message.

methods.name: rbuscore_FindClientPrivateConnection
methods.description: Finds if a private connection exists for a parameter.

methods.name: rbuscore_createPrivateConnection
methods.description: Creates a private connection to a provider.

methods.name: rbuscore_closePrivateConnection
methods.description: Closes a private connection.

methods.name: rbuscore_terminatePrivateConnection
methods.description: Terminates all private connections for a provider.

methods.name: rbuscore_startPrivateListener
methods.description: Starts a private listener for a DML.

methods.name: rbuscore_updatePrivateListener
methods.description: Updates or removes a private listener.

methods.name: rbus_sendData
methods.description: Sends raw data with a topic.
